content:
Art Streams Artista ako! Mag-i-stream ako ng mas maraming art streams! Nag-stream ako dalwang ng art stream para sa itong linggo. Nag-draw ako ng pagsalitang taco para sa buong na unang stream. Masaya at kawili-wiling na ito. Ipinagpatuloy ko ang ating wallpaper para sa pangalwang stream. Baka malapit na natin itong matapos sa susunod na linggo!
Game Streams Tapas na ang Final Fantasy VI!! Naglabanan tayo ng Kefka at nanalo tayo! Nag-save rin tayo Sumeru sa Genshin Impact, pero sinunog ang Irminsul. Gayunpaman okay si Nahida! At sa wakas nakarating na rin tayo sa Snezhnaya.
Final Fantasy VI We fought Kefka and we won. Heartless angel is one heck of an attack, but he didn't use it to often and our cures are stronk! Also reraise and arise are good spells! I also had time to play a game I haven't played in a very long time!
Genshin Impact We saved Sumeru, but also destroyed the old world tree. It seems Nahida had planned for this though and, with a little help from Nicole, is going to be just find with a new tree of knowledge. With all that taking care of, it was time to head to Snezhneya!
Next Week Tatlo na lang ang stream natin sa susunod na linggo. Dalawa na art stream at una na game stream, pero magkakaroon tayo ng VN Nite! Okay ba? Manood nang live sa Twitch at magsiyasat kayo ang aking arkibos sa Odysee.

title: Stream Recap: 9 Nov

content:
Game Streams Lumipas na ang huling linggo natin para sa Spooky Month. Nag-play tayo Higurashi no Naku Koro ni at The Many Deaths of Lily Kosen at Corpse Party: Book of Shadows para sa itong linggo. Nag-play rin tayo Resident Evil 2, pero 'di ko nagustuhan.'di mag-pa-play tayo Resident Evil 2 muli, malamang. Nag-play tayo 100% Orange Juice nagkasama para sa ating Spooky Month Finale at Nag-play rin tayo Fatal Frame II, pero 'di nagkasama. Itong huling linggo na Spooky Month ang pinakamabuting na linggo!
Higurashi no Naku Koro ni The cat couldn't help himself, he just had to keep worrying. Maybe this was a good thing though. Maybe, by worrying he was able to uncover something. What if, however, he won't like what he sees. Should he have just kept meowing and left everything to Rika?
The Many Deaths of Lily Kosen Well, seems we found out what we wanted to talk about. It had to do with the ritual in the prologue. Did a demon really come and possess our friend!? I mean we stabbed her, so that had to have happened, right!? Wait, who is this that has joined our camp?
Resident Evil 2 We made it out of the station, but were a bit locked out still. Turns out we need a key card to leave the parking garage, so we had to head back in and see if we could find out how to get at one. Not find one, finding it was easy, finding away to get it, that's what's hard. Also, BEEG zombie!!
Corpse Party: Book of Shadows Morishige doesn't recognize the girl that had become the masterpiece in the collection. She said not to look. That she didn't want to be seen that way. Only he can't stop looking. It is all that keeps him grounded, or so he believes. Is this corpse party the perfect place for him!?
2026 Spooky Month Finale And ending for the ages, at least until 2027. This started with 100% Orange Juice with kittens and ended with another fight with Chitose in Fatal Frame II. Chitose was the little girl spirit, Ituski's sister, who kept hiding and took me forever. This time I just threw whatever I could at her and we won, after we didn't XD Fun times!
Next Week Tapos na ang Spooky Month. Babalik tayo sa ating karaniwang iskedyul ngayong linggo. Kaya mag-sta-stream ako ang aking art! Magkakaroon tayo dalawa na art stream at dalawa na game stream! Manood nang live sa Twitch at magsiyasat kayo ang aking arkibos sa Odysee.

title: Stream Recap: 2 Nov

content:
Game Streams Walang art stream sa itong linggo. Cincong mga video game stream na lang. Nag-play tayo Higurashi no Naku Koro ni, The Many Deaths of Lily Kosin (bagong video game!), Corpse Party: Book of Shadows, at Fatal Frame II. Mayroon tayo and bonus stream! Tapos na ang Fatal Frame! Kaya, nag-play rin tayo Resident Evil 2! Malumbay na ang katapusan ng Fatal Frame II 😭 Sa Ingles ang mga paglalarawan sa ibaba.
Higurashi no Naku Koro ni There was once a group of four cats. One cat convinced two of the other cats to entered the forbidden ritual storehouse. You see the cats always wanted to see what was inside, but their owner (Rika-chamma) was mean I didn't let them in. They took a peek though and now the cats are scared. Don't worry cats, just keep meowing. Rika-chamma isn't mad, she'll protect you!
The Many Deaths of Lily Kosen It's a camping trip, eh? Apparently the main character has something she wants to do there other than just camping. Things are also a little strange. Was that really just a twig we stepped on? Why isn't anyone else here on a weekend? Well it's probably nothing. Let's get on with the plan!
Corpse Party: Book of Shadows Nag-play tayo Corpse Party sa dalawang gabi. Yui ang pinagmumultuhan ng aswang sa unang gabi, pero marahil isang ang iyang panaginip. Habang, nag-imbestiga ang Naho ng Heavenly Host Elementary School sa panganlawang gabi.
Nite 1 Maybe it was all just a dream. I mean a ghost that can nearly break your arm just by twisting it? That can't possibly happen, right? And, like that old lady I couldn't have seen her, right? I mean they said she died. Yeah it must all just been a dream.
Nite 2 Well, Naho will be Naho I suppose. She'll do anything for her sensei, even put her best friend at risk. Of course, he shouldn't have gone in without her. Still did she even try to look for Sayaka after she convinced her to go with her?
Fatal Frame II/Resident Evil 2 It turns out, we weren't able to escape the ritual. It all seemed to happen just as it was supposed to. Now Mio is alone, maybe? As far what is happening in Raccoon City, I have no shtinkin clue!
Next Week Malapit nang matapos ang nating Spooky Month! Tapusin naman tayo lahat ng mga spooky games sa susunod na linggo. Manood nang live sa Twitch at magsiyasat kayo ang aking arkibos sa Odysee.

title: Stream Recap: 26 Oct

content:
Art Timelapse Magusto ako ng klase White Mage sa Final Fantasy XIV. Gutso Mag-cosplay sa klase White Mage ko. Kaya, nagguhit ako ng aking avatar sa pag-cosplayng White Mage pero 'di dahil magusto ako and klase rito. Kasi nag-pa-play tayo ng Final Fantasy VI. Bahagi ang kono pagguhit sa aking wallpaper serye.
Game Streams Nag-play tayo tatlong video games sa itong linggo. Sa Ingles ang mga paglalarawan sa ibaba. Kasi pagtamad ako ;p Jokes nalang. Sa YouTube ang paglalarawan rito. Sa Ingles lamang ang aking YouTube Channel sa ngayon.
Higurashi no Naku Koro ni We might just be the next victims. We did something we shouldn't have. We're sorry. We're sorry. We're sorry. We're sorry. We're sorry. We're sorry.
Fatal Frame II REMAKE Dalawang gabi para sa Fatal Frame II REMAKE! Malapit na tayo tapusin siya! Si Mayu Yae ba or si Mayu Mayu?
Nite 1 We lost the Camera Obscura! It was the only thing that could keep us safe from the spirits and we lost it. We also found the white spirit again. Yae, I think her name is. Or is Yae just Mayu? Honestly it is hard to tell sometimes. Well, we did get Mayu back so that's something, no?
Nite 2 We are nearing the end. We are on the final chapter. We have once again been separated from Mayu, but this time we know where they're taking her and we have already unlocked all the doors. Can we rescue her though?
Corpse Party: Book of Shadows Dalawang gabi rin para sa Corpse Party: Book of Shadows. Mayroon din itong karakter na nanggalang Mayu, ngunit ibang babae siya. Mayroon din ang karakter na nangalangang Yui-sensei at Yui-sensei nakakaharap Heavenly Host Elementary mauna sa mga estudyante niya ( o . o )!
Nite 1 So, I asked if it could get worse for Mayu. Sachiko just had to answer. I won't spoil it though. We did save Nana and tried to change our fate and, though we didn't know it, hers a well. Thing is…I think Sachiko might be right…We…can't…change…fate…
Nite 2 This chapter is a little different. I didn't remember exactly how different it was until near the end of stream, but I'll say, it is really cool to see Yui-sensei when she was younger. What happens to her, is less cool, but I suppose there is still some hope.
Next Week Mag-pa-play ang bagon video game sa sasunod na linggo. Tinatawag The Many Deaths of Lily Kosen na ito. Mag-pa-play rin Higurashi at Corpse Party. Magpapasiya kayo anong mag-pa-play kayo sa Sabado. Manood nang live sa Twitch at magsiyasat kayo ang aking arkibos sa Odysee.

title: Stream Recap: 19 Oct

content:
Ya'llo ang aking mga kitten!
Ipinanganak ako sa Amerika pero ang aking pamilya taga sa Luzon. Sa bahay nasasalta ang aking ama (Ya-pa) at ang aking ina (Ya-ma) ng Ingles. Nagsimula akong iskul sa Amerika. Kaya ang aking unang lenggwahe ng Ingles.
Noong bata pa ako, natuto ako ng Tagalog. Lumipat ang pagkatapos kami sa Makati. 'di ako magaling mag-Tagalog. Kaya 'di ako nagsalita sa mga kaklase ko. Sa klase, nakaupon akong mag-isa. 'di ako kausapin ang aking kaklase pero mabuti ako sa pag-aaral. Gusto ako pag-aaral, pero 'di akong gusto iskul sa Makati. Mamaya, lumipat kami sa Ternate, Cavite. Maliit ang iskul sa Ternate pero nakaupon rin akong mag-isa. Naisip ng mga kaklase ko mapagmalaki ako. Mas Amerikano raw siya kaysa Pilipinas. Sa kabila noon, minahal ko ang Ternate. Mabuti at Maganda ang Ternate.
Bago ako tumungtong sa hayskul, panahon na para lumipat kami muli. Kailangan naming bumalik sa Amerika. Naisip nina Ya-ma at Ya-Pa na ito ang makakabuti para sa kapatid ko (Ya-nee) at ako. 'di ko alam kung kumusta ang hayskul sa Amerika o sa Pilipinas pero alam ko magusta-gusta ang pagabasa at pag-aaral. 'di mabuti ako pa rin ang aking Tagalog, pero mahal ko ang Pilipinas. Ipinagmamalaki kong maging Pilipina, pero Amerikana rin ako. Philam ako!
title: Philam Ako

content:
Hello (o "Ya'llo" parang gustong sabihin)!
Yayoi ang aking panagalan at ng magical fairy pusang prinsesa mula sa ang kahima-himalang kaharian ng Eternal Rain ako. Ipinadala ako rito para sa protektahan ang mundong ito. Dahil sa aking expedisyon dito, 'di akong makapagsilta. Kaya, kinailangan ako ang hanap ng ibang paraang para makipag-usap.
Akong gusto protektahan ang aking mga kitten at nagpapalaganap ng postibo at pagmamahal. Ginagawa ko ito sa ng internet. Sa ng internet mag-stream akong iba't iban video games at mag-chat akong sa aking mga kittens sa aking Twitch at aking YouTube channel.
Maraming maraming salamat para sa pagbabasa. Sana makilala kita! Bye bye!
